scenes.head: Guidelines *V2.1* are out
scenes.sub: UAE Electronic Invoicing Guidelines, Version 2.1, 25 Nov 2026 (UAE Ministry of Finance). Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF.

lines.say: The UAE e-invoicing guidelines changed on the twenty-fifth of November.
Version two point one. Here's what it means for your E.R.P.
lines.cap: Version *2.1*. What it means for your ERP.

scenes.myth: Send it as a tax invoice, *code 380*.

lines.say: An invoice made up only of exempt supplies.
Version two point one puts it on code four eighty, the commercial invoice.

items.t: Foreign buyer IDs from their own country

lines.say: Foreign buyers can use an I.D. from their own country.
Credit notes for retention need a reason code.
And reverse-charge goods lines carry a product code.
The go-live dates stay the same.

scenes.disc: General information only, not legal or tax advice. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF. Valorin is not an ASP. Source: UAE Electronic Invoicing Guidelines V2.1, 25 Nov 2026.

lines.say: Updating your invoice mapping? Send us a WhatsApp, and we'll go through version two point one with you.
